observations: Photo 0: A complete engine assembly with transmission/transaxle, front struts and coil springs still attached, sitting on wet pavement in a yard. A watermark reads 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'EZE PORSCHE GLOBAL AUTOS'.
Photo 1: Same or similar engine/transmission unit viewed from a different angle, surrounded by other stripped engines and suspension parts in a cluttered yard.

Photo 2: Another angle of the same unit showing the transmission housing, red fuel-rail/injector covers, and black engine cover with an oval opening; no VIN plate, engine code sticker, or brand badge is legible in any shot.
No manufacturer logo, part number, or engine code is readable on the cover, block, or transmission casing in any of the three photos.
The item appears to be a 'complete engine' pull including attached front suspension struts and transmission, consistent with a used/tokunbo import yard pull.

identity.kind: complete engine with transmission and front struts (used import, make/model not legible)

claims.evidence: No shipping documents, customs paperwork, or import tag visible in any photo.
No test video, compression test, or running clip shown; engine is static and partially disassembled with struts attached.
No audio/video evidence of the engine running.
No odometer, mileage sticker, or donor-vehicle documentation visible.
Valve/cam covers and oil pan are not shown removed or sealed; no factory seal or bolt-torque marks visible to confirm.

risks.risk: Engine make/model/displacement cannot be confirmed, which is the primary price driver (range in comparables spans from small inline engines to V8 Porsche units).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code sticker, cylinder head casting number, or any VIN/data plate on the block or transmission.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this identification; price range is too wide to assign a worst case

risks.risk: Mechanical condition (compression, oil leaks, internal wear) cannot be assessed from static photos.
risks.proof: Video of the engine running/idling with audible sound, or a compression test report.

risks.risk: Mileage claim is unsupported and the engine could be high-mileage or rebuilt.
risks.proof: Odometer photo from the donor vehicle or Belgian import paperwork showing mileage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/high mileage (no premium for 'low mileage')

risks.risk: Missing or damaged ancillary parts (turbo, injectors, sensors, wiring harness) not visible in cluttered yard photos.
risks.proof: Full 360° photos of the engine bay side, intake, and wiring harness connectors.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete unless full ancillary set is shown

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code / data plate / casting number on the block or cylinder head.
Video of the engine running (idle and revved) with audible sound.
Photo of the donor vehicle's VIN plate or Belgian export/import documentation.
Photo of the odometer or mileage certificate from the donor car.
Full-view photos showing intake, turbo (if any), and wiring harness completeness.
response.reason: The engine's make, model and displacement — the key determinant of price among the listed comparables (750,000 to 5,000,000 NGN) — cannot be read from any of the three photos, so even a worst-case price cannot be fairly assigned without an identifying shot.
